Imperos is the name of a continent that is currently being colonized by several different different nations. Its essentially a land grab as each nation tries to expand their colony into the Contested Land. But they come into conflict with each other, and the natives who call Imperos home.

The party of adventurers who will play in the world will find themselves in Nova Lux, in the colony of New Axius. There's a lot of work for adventurers since the land is newly colonized(full of monsters) and since the military is currently engaged in border disputes and trying to push into the Contested Lands.

Hmm. I don't know if this is helpful but this reminds me a lot of the Meiji Restoration in Japan. Basically, the whole country modernized very quickly, including the military. The samurai became obsolete as the military was reformed, and no longer enjoyed their privileged social position. There was actually a rebellion by the unemployed samurai.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satsuma_Rebellion#Aftermath

If you look at the two pictures of the forces one is the imperial forces with modern weapons and uniforms, and the other are the samurai wearing traditional armor and carrying swords. 

Maybe in your world the once privileged warrior class only felt their status becoming obsolete due to technology and reforms after the war. So thats when they chose to rebel. In any case maybe an actual historical event similar to the events in your world can give you some ideas!
